HOW TO USE
==========

.. image:: asset:web/ja-cc30a/eu/en/how-to-use-steps-0-1
   :alt: Steps 0 and 1. Place the heating module on the side of the bag with its heating surface close to the Power Station, secure it with the strap, and place the Power Station in the bag.
   :width: 100%

.. image:: asset:web/ja-cc30a/eu/en/how-to-use-step-2
   :alt: Step 2. Open the front cover, turn on the Power Station and its DC output, and connect the heating module USB interface; the inset identifies the indicator lights.
   :width: 100%

.. image:: asset:web/ja-cc30a/eu/en/how-to-use-steps-3-4
   :alt: Steps 3 and 4. Turn on the heating module switch, check the green power and red heating indicators, then open the front and top for cold-environment use.
   :width: 100%

UNFOLD BOTH SIDES OF THE CARRYING BAG AND USE THE SUPPORT BARS
-------------------------------------------------------------

When the Power Station needs to dissipate heat or connect to a solar panel, open the zippers on both sides, unfold the support bars at the same time, and fix them with the hook-and-loop fasteners.

.. image:: asset:web/ja-cc30a/eu/en/support-bars
   :alt: Open both side zippers, unfold the support bars on both sides, and secure the hook-and-loop fasteners.
   :width: 100%
